698410102.text: Lyney, what are you doing here?

698410103.text: #{NICKNAME}! I never imagined I'd run into you here... Seems I owe that gust just now an apology, ha!

698410104.text: It blew my hat away, seemingly for no reason — but no sooner had I caught it than I ran into you!

698410105.text: Planning a visit to the Institute, are we?

698410106.text: Yeah... There's a researcher I'm looking for, one who's also interested in magic. He said he'd like to talk shop with me.

698410107.text: Word is that he's invented all kinds of fantastic devices that are perfect for some truly amazing tricks!

698410108.text: For example, he once made a miniature thermos that he kept stuffed up his sleeve.

698410109.text: All he had to do was twitch his finger to activate the mechanism, and voila! The ice within would slide down and out through his sleeve! The "Ice Trick" — one of his myriad magic tricks.

698410112.text: Hahaha! Of course it counts! Just think about it. You're a poor office worker, sweltering behind your desk. You want nothing more than to head out and buy an ice-cold Fonta to quench your thirst.

698410113.text: But it's just way too hot. The Fonta machine's broken, and only dispenses warm Fonta. And there's no ice anywhere in the office...

698410114.text: Just as you totter on the edge of despair, the colleague besides you claps their hands, and a few ice cubes suddenly appear in your cup of Fonta... Just imagine. How would you feel?
